Source: STDI-0002-2 v2021.1, Appendix L: WEATHER_DATA DES
Name: Weather Data DES
Description: The WEATHER_DATA Data Extension Segment (DES) provides a means to encode meteorological and oceanographic (METOC) data, including weather data, within a National Imagery Transmission Format (NITF) version 2.1 dataset. When a sensor remotely detects a signal, the intervening space (i.e., medium) between the sensor and the source of that signal may affect the quality of the signal received by the sensor, and the WEATHER_DATA DES characterizes the properties of that intervening space. For example, when an airborne panchromatic sensor images the ground, the atmosphere, i.e., weather, affects the quality of the image. Clouds may obscure the ground, aerosols may reduce contrast between objects, and the edges of objects may be less sharp compared to ground-level observations. Data collected by sensors in space and in the marine environment may also be affected by the intervening atmosphere, oceans, and space environment. As a result, information about atmospheric conditions (i.e., weather), the ocean, and the space environment, also known as METOC data, are needed in order to determine their influence on remotely sensed data.

DE.Name: File Part Type
DE.Description: This field shall contain the characters DE to identify the subheader as a data extension.

DESID.Name: Unique DES Type Identifier
DESID.Description: This field shall contain a valid alphanumeric identifier properly registered with the NTB.

DESVER.Name: Version of the Data Definition
DESVER.Description: This field shall contain a valid alphanumeric identifier properly registered with the NTB.

DESCLAS.Name: DES Security Classification
DESCLAS.Description: This field shall contain a valid value representing the classification level of the DES. Valid values are T for Top Secret, S for Secret, C for Confidential, R for Restricted, and U for Unclassified.

DESCLSY.Name: DES Security Classification System
DESCLSY.Description: This field shall contain valid values indicating the national or multinational security system used to classify the DES. Country Codes per FIPS PUB 10-4 are used to indicate national security systems. The designator XN is for classified data generated by a component using NATO security system marking guidance. This code is outside the FIPS 10-4 document listing, and was selected to not duplicate that document's existing codes. If this field is all ECS spaces (code 0x20), it shall imply that no Security Classification System applies to the DES.

DESCODE.Name: DES Codewords
DESCODE.Description: This field shall contain a valid indicator of the security compartments associated with the DES. Values include one or more of the digraphs found in table A-4. Multiple entries shall be separated by a single ECS space (0x20). The selection of a relevant set of codewords is application specific. If this field is all ECS spaces (0x20), it shall imply that no codewords apply to the DES.

Values.WN: WARNING NOTICE-SEC CLAS IS BASED ON THE FACT OF EXISTENCE AND AVAIL OF THIS GRAPHIC

DESCTLH.Name: DES Control and Handling
DESCTLH.Description: This field shall contain valid additional security control and/or handling instructions (caveats) associated with the DES. Values include digraphs found in table A-4. The digraph may indicate single or multiple caveats. The selection of a relevant caveat(s) is application specific. If this field is all ECS spaces (0x20), it shall imply that no additional control and handling instructions apply to the DES.

Values.WN: WARNING NOTICE-SEC CLAS IS BASED ON THE FACT OF EXISTENCE AND AVAIL OF THIS GRAPHIC

DESREL.Name: DES Releasing Instructions
DESREL.Description: This field shall contain a valid list of countries to which the DES is authorized for release. Typical values include one or more country codes as found in FIPS PUB 10-4 separated by a single BCS space (0x20). If this field is all ECS spaces (0x20), it shall imply that no DES release instructions apply.

Values.SH: SAINT HELENA, ASCENSION, AND TRISTAN DA CUNHA
Values.SX: SOUTH GEORGIA AND SOUTH SANDWICH ISLANDS

DESDCTP.Name: DES Classification Type
DESDCTP.Description: This field shall contain a valid indicator of the type of security declassification or downgrading instructions which apply to the DES. Valid values are DD for declassify on a specific date, DE for declassify upon occurrence of an event, GD for downgrade to a specified level on a specific date, GE for downgrade to a specified level upon occurrence of an event, O for OADR, and X for exempt from automatic declassification. If this field is all ECS spaces (0x20), it shall imply that no DES security declassification or downgrading instructions apply.

DESDCDT.Name: DES Declassification Date
DESDCDT.Description: This field shall indicate the date on which a DES is to be declassified if the value in DESDCTP is DD. If this field is all ECS spaces (0x20), it shall imply that no DES declassification date applies.

DESDCXM.Name: DES Declassification Exemption
DESDCXM.Description: This field shall indicate the reason the DES is exempt from automatic declassification if the value in DESDCTP is X. Valid values are X1 to X8 and X251 to X259. X1 to X8 correspond to the declassification exemptions found in DOD 5200.1-R, paragraphs 4-202b(1) to (8) for material exempt from the 10-year rule. X251 to X259 correspond to the declassification exemptions found in DOD 5200.1-R, paragraphs 4-301a(1) to (9) for permanently valuable material exempt from the 25-year declassification system. If this field is all ECS spaces (0x20), it shall imply that a DES declassification exemption does not apply.

DESDG.Name: DES Downgrade
DESDG.Description: This field shall indicate the classification level to which a DES is to be downgraded if the values in DESDCTP are GD or GE. Valid values are S for Secret, C for Confidential, R for Restricted. If this field contains an ECS space (0x20), it shall imply that DES security downgrading does not apply.

DESDGDT.Name: DES Downgrade Date
DESDGDT.Description: This field shall indicate the date on which a DES is to be downgraded if the value in DESDCTP is GD. If this field is all ECS spaces (0x20), it shall imply that a DES security downgrading date does not apply.

DESCLTX.Name: DES Classification Text
DESCLTX.Description: This field shall be used to provide additional information about DES classification to include identification of a declassification or downgrading event if the values in DESDCTP are DE or GE. It may also be used to identify multiple classification sources and/or any other special handling rules. Values are user-defined free text. If this field is all ECS spaces (0x20), it shall imply that additional information about DES classification does not apply.

DESCATP.Name: DES Classification Authority Type
DESCATP.Description: This field shall indicate the type of authority used to classify the DES. Valid values are O for original classification authority, D for derivative from a single source, and M for derivative from multiple sources. If this field contains an ECS space (0x20), it shall imply that DES DESCATP does not apply.

DESCAUT.Name: DES Classification Authority
DESCAUT.Description: This field shall identify the classification authority for the DES dependent upon the value in DESCATP. Values are user-defined free text which should contain the following information: original classification authority name and position or personal ID if the value in DESCATP is O; title of the document or security classification guide used to classify the DES if the value in DESCATP is D; and Deriv Multiple if the DES classification was derived from multiple sources. In the latter case, the DES originator will maintain a record of the sources used in accordance with existing security directives. One of the multiple sources may also be identified in DESCLTX if desired. If this field is all ECS spaces (0x20), it shall imply that no DES file classification authority applies.

DESCRSN.Name: DES Classification Reason
DESCRSN.Description: This field shall contain a value indicating the reason for classifying the DES. Valid values are A to G. These correspond to the reasons for original classification per E.O. 12958, Section 1.5.(a) to(g). If this field contains an ECS spaces (0x20), it shall imply that no DES classification reason applies.

DESSRDT.Name: DES Security Source Data
DESSRDT.Description: This field shall indicate the date of the source used to derive the classification of the DES. In the case of multiple sources, the date of the most recent source shall be used. If this field is all ECS spaces (0x20), it shall imply that a DES security source date does not apply.

DESCTLN.Name: DES Security Control Number
DESCTLN.Description: This field shall contain a valid security control number associated with the DES. The format of the security control number shall be in accordance with the regulations governing the appropriate security channel(s). If this field is all ECS spaces (0x20), it shall imply that no DES security control number applies.

DESSHL.Name: DES User-Defined Subheader Length
DESSHL.Description: This field shall contain the number of bytes in the field DESSHF. If this field contains BCS zeros (0x30), then DESSHF shall not appear in the DES subheader.

DES_DATE_TIME.Name: Date and Time of DES Creation
DES_DATE_TIME.Description: This field shall contain the time of the WEATHER_DATA DES creation.

DES_WRITER_NAME.Name: DES Writer Name
DES_WRITER_NAME.Description: This field shall contain the name of the software used to create this instance of the WEATHER_DATA DES.

DES_WRITER_VERSION.Name: DES Writer Version
DES_WRITER_VERSION.Description: This field shall contain the version of the software used to create this instance of the WEATHER_DATA DES.

DES_UUID.Name: UUID Assigned to this DES
DES_UUID.Description: This UUID refers to the entire instance of this DES, i.e., both the subheader and data portions of the DES.

NUMAIS.Name: Number of Associated Image Segments
NUMAIS.Description: This field provides the number of image segments associated with this DES. If NUMAIS = ALL, the DES is associated with all image segments in the NITF dataset, and field AISDLVLn is omitted. Otherwise, NUMAIS is between 0 and 998 (999 is covered by ALL) and is no more than the number of image segments in the dataset.

AISDLV<NUMAIS>.Name: Nth Associated Image Segment Display Level
AISDLV<NUMAIS>.Description: This field provides the Image Display Level (IDLVL) of each image segment associated with this DES. AISDLVLn shall correspond to IDLVL values of image segments in the same dataset. If NUMAIS = 0 or ALL, then this field is omitted.

NUM_SHAPEFILE.Name: Number of Associated Shapefile DESs
NUM_SHAPEFILE.Description: This field provides the number of shapefile DESs associated with this DES. If NUM_SHAPEFILES = ALL, the DES is associated with all shapefile DESs in the NITF dataset. If NUM_ SHAPEFILES = 0 or ALL, field SHAPEFILE_UUIDn is omitted.

SHAPEFILE_UUID.Name: UUID of nth Associated Shapefile DES
SHAPEFILE_UUID.Description: This field provides the UUID value of each shapefile DES associated with this DES. For the CSSHPB DES, SHAPEFILE_UUIDn shall correspond to SHAPEFILE_ID value(s). If NUM_ SHAPEFILES = 0 or ALL, this field is omitted.

NUM_ASSOC_ELEM.Name: Number of Associated Elements
NUM_ASSOC_ELEM.Description: This field contains the number of elements associated with this DES, besides any shapefiles DESs, that have assigned UUIDs.

ASSOC_ELEM_UUID<NUM_ASSOC_ELEM>.Name: UUID of the nth Associated Element
ASSOC_ELEM_UUID<NUM_ASSOC_ELEM>.Description: This field contains the UUID of the nth element associated with this DES. The type of associated element is unrestricted. If NUM_ASSOC_ELEM= 0, this field is omitted.

METOC_WRITER_NAME.Name: METOC Writer Name
METOC_WRITER_NAME.Description: This field shall contain the name of the software used to create the METOC dataset stored in the user-defined data (DESDATA) portion of this DES.

METOC_WRITER_VERSION.Name: METOC Writer Version
METOC_WRITER_VERSION.Description: This field shall contain the version of the software used to create the METOC dataset stored in the user-defined data (DESDATA) portion of this DES.

ATMOS_FLAG.Name: Atmosheric Data Flag
ATMOS_FLAG.Description: This field indicates whether the METOC dataset stored in the DESDATA portion of this DES contains information about the atmospheric environment.

OCEAN_FLAG.Name: Oceanographic Data Flag
OCEAN_FLAG.Description: This field indicates whether the METOC dataset stored in the DESDATA portion of this DES contains information about the marine environment, whether oceanographic or limnologic, at the surface of the body of water, below the water surface, or both.

SPACE_FLAG.Name: Space Data Flag
SPACE_FLAG.Description: This field indicates whether the METOC dataset stored in the DESDATA portion of this DES contains information about the space environment.

METOC_SOURCE.Name: Source of the METOC Dataset
METOC_SOURCE.Description: This field designates the name of the organization that created the METOC information in this WEATHER_DATA DES.

METOC_SOURCE_FORCE.Name: U.S. Armed Forces Non-Traditional METOC Source Identifier
METOC_SOURCE_FORCE.Description: This field shall report the branch ofthe U.S. Armed Forces that acquired the non-traditional source of METOC data. See Table L.6-1 for approved values, or the NITFS Field Value Registry.

METOC_SOURCE_FORCE_UNIT.Name: U.S. Armed Forces Non-Traditional METOC Source Unit-Level Identifier
METOC_SOURCE_FORCE_UNIT.Description: This field shall contain a free text string which can be used to identify the unit-level source of the non-traditional METOC data. For more information about the use of this field, refer to JP 3-59 for information concerning non-traditional sources of METOC data collected by the U.S. Armed Forces.

METOC_FORMAT.Name: U.S. Armed Forces Non-Traditional METOC Source Unit-Level Identifier
METOC_FORMAT.Description: This field specifies the name and version of the METOC dataset stored in the DESDATA field of this WEATHER_DATA DES.

COM_SIZE.Name: Size in Bytes of the Comment Block
COM_SIZE.Description: This field shall report the number of bytes used to record the block of free text.

COMMENTS.Name: Free Text Comment Block
COMMENTS.Description: This field contains a block of user defined free text. The size in bytes of the comment block is determined by the COM_SIZE field value. If the value of COM_SIZE is 0000, then this field shall be omitted.

CREATION_TIMESTAMP.Name: Creation Timestamp of the METOC Dataset
CREATION_TIMESTAMP.Description: This field reports the timestamp associated with the creation of the METOC dataset.

VALID_TIMESTAMP.Name: Validity Timestamp of the METOC Dataset
VALID_TIMESTAMP.Description: This field reports the timestamp for when the METOC data are valid or applicable. In addition, if location information is also provided in this DES Subheader, then the validity of the METOC data is extended to both the timestamp and the reported geographic extent.

METOC_GENERATION.Name: Generation or Type of the METOC Dataset
METOC_GENERATION.Description: This field indicates whether the METOC dataset was generated using observed or prognostic model data, or some combination. Acceptable values for this field are tied to the registered/allowed list of METOC_FORMAT field values. Note that while the various GRIB formats report their generation/type information as integer numeric codes, their equivalent human-readable strings are what get recorded in the METOC_GENERATION field.

LOCATION_SHAPE.Name: Location Shape
LOCATION_SHAPE.Description: This field indicates the shape of the location information applicable to the METOC dataset, if any.

NUMPTS.Name: Number of Points
NUMPTS.Description: This field indicates the number of points required to provide the location information. If the definition of a LOCATION_SHAPE requires that the points be specified in a pre-defined order, such as LOCATION_SHAPE = VOLUME, then the points shall be listed in the required order.

LOC_ELEV_REF.Name: Reference for Location Point Elevation
LOC_ELEV_REF.Description: This field indicates the vertical reference from which elevation information for the LOCATION_POINT_Zn field is reported. Default choice is HAE for heights with respect to the WGS 84 ellipsoid.

LOCATION_POINT_X<NUMPTS>.Name: Longitude of the Point
LOCATION_POINT_X<NUMPTS>.Description: This field shall contain the longitude of the n th geographic point associated with the METOC dataset in this instance of the WEATHER_DATA DES. Positive longitudes are east of the Prime Meridian, negative longitudes are west of the Prime Meridian, and zero-valued entries may have either sign; -000.000000000 is equivalent to +000.000000000.

LOCATION_POINT_Y<NUMPTS>.Name: Latitude of the Point
LOCATION_POINT_Y<NUMPTS>.Description: This field shall contain the latitude of the n th geographic point associated with the METOC dataset in this instance of the WEATHER_DATA DES. Positive latitudes are north of the Equator, negative latitudes are south of the Equator, and zero-valued entries may have either sign; -00.000000000 is equivalent to +00.000000000.

LOCATION_POINT_Z<NUMPTS>.Name: Height Above Vertical Datum
LOCATION_POINT_Z<NUMPTS>.Description: This field shall contain the latitude of the n th geographic point associated with the METOC dataset in this instance of the WEATHER_DATA DES. Positive latitudes are north of the Equator, negative latitudes are south of the Equator, and zero-valued entries may have either sign; -00.000000000 is equivalent to +00.000000000.

METOC_DATA.Name: Embedded METOC Dataset
METOC_DATA.Description: This field shall be treated as a single block of data for extraction from the NITF file. Parsing the native format of the METOC dataset is beyond the scope of this DES; applications capable of reading these METOC datasets will be required for proper exploitation.
